hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Custom muted palette and clean card/control UI show design intent, but the circle pack is visibly clipped at the bottom of the viewport — a concrete layout bug — and labels render as bare IDs (s0, g1) with no typographic hierarchy.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout radius and area-proportional D3 layouts throughout, but bundle path joins use positional index as key (d,i)=>i instead of stable identity, creating a permutation vulnerability where shuffled connections corrupt DOM reuse.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The d3.timer started in updateNodes() (line 418) is never cancelled when a transition is interrupted mid-flight—because t.on('end') never fires after .interrupt()—causing the timer to run drawBundles()/drawHierLinks() indefinitely on every RAF frame; the slider and force layout correctly use RAF coalescing and a dirty-flag pattern, and .interrupt() is called before all new transitions, but no touch-event filtering is present for mobile drag conflicts.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle pack reads cleanly with well-separated 7-color groups, but layering 300 near-invisible bundle connections (0.15 opacity) beneath the hierarchy, offering 7 simultaneous layout modes, and animating 200+ nodes at once fragments attention across competing conceptual frames without a clear primary message.
